findings.evidence: `TauCeti.Algebra.DirectSum.Internal` lines 179–182 provides `Submodule.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep_of_fg` with exactly this weaker hypothesis, while line 247 instead invokes the Noetherian-only Mathlib theorem.
findings.fix: Prove the general theorem with an explicit hypothesis `(⨆ c, GroupLike.weightSpace (M := M) c).FG` using `Submodule.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep_of_fg`, then derive the Noetherian corollary and existing `Finite` instance from it.
findings.issue: `finite_setOf_groupLikeWeightSpace_ne_bot` assumes `[IsNoetherian k M]`, although only `(⨆ c, GroupLike.weightSpace c).FG` is needed; this excludes non-Noetherian ambient modules whose weight-space span is finitely generated.

summary: The finite-support theorem is stated with an unnecessarily global Noetherian assumption instead of the natural finite-generation hypothesis on the span of the weight spaces.
